# RogueIQ

> Get Smarter About Money. Market tools and verified money news that show where the market stands today, for people and their AI agents. Every claim carries a primary source and date. No buy/sell calls or picks.

RogueIQ provides general education and tools, not personalized investment, tax or legal advice. Data may be delayed or contain errors; check the source before making decisions. Nothing on this site is an offer or solicitation to buy or sell any security.

## The RogueIQ Wire (start here)

Major releases from U.S. government agencies and official sources (Fed, BLS, BEA, Treasury, OFAC, SEC, EDGAR, CFTC, DOJ, Nasdaq halts) as structured data. Free, no auth.

- [Web app](https://rogueiq.com/wire/)
- [MCP server (streamable HTTP, read-only)](https://rogueiq.com/wire/mcp): tools list_items, get_item, get_breakdown, get_calendar, get_heads_up
- [JSON API base](https://rogueiq.com/wire/v1): e.g. /v1/items, /v1/calendar, /v1/breakdown/{id}
- [OpenAPI spec](https://rogueiq.com/wire/openapi.json)
- [Docs](https://rogueiq.com/wire/docs/)
- [Wire llms.txt](https://rogueiq.com/wire/llms.txt)
- [Wire SKILL.md](https://rogueiq.com/wire/SKILL.md)
- [Wire item pages](https://rogueiq.com/wire/sitemap.xml): one page per release at https://rogueiq.com/wire/item/{id}/

## Net worth by age

Where a net worth ranks among U.S. families of the same age, from the Federal Reserve's 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances (2025 dollars). Free, no auth.

- [Web checker](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/)
- [MCP server (streamable HTTP, read-only)](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/mcp): tool networth_percentile_by_age
- [JSON API](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/v1/networth-by-age?age=34&net_worth=150000)
- [OpenAPI spec](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/openapi.json)
- [llms.txt](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/llms.txt)
- [SKILL.md](https://rogueiq.com/net-worth-by-age/api/SKILL.md)

## For agents

- [Agents page](https://rogueiq.com/agents/): every endpoint and a config snippet in one place
